name: portfolio
description: A full-stack dynamic portfolio website built with the **MERN** stack. Users can register, log in, manage their profile and projects through a dashboard, and share a unique public portfolio URL. Visitors without an account see a default public portfolio.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
